points.description: Classification: defines it as the task/process of mapping (input) data to discrete labels/classes/categories. Equivalent wording accepted (e.g. predicting a category).
Regression: defines it as a task/method that maps/predicts data to continuous values (e.g. a continuous number, real-valued output, or range of values). Equivalent wording accepted.
Error in classification is measured by the count/number (or proportion) of misclassifications (e.g. misclassification rate, accuracy).
Error in regression is measured by the summed distance/difference between true and predicted values (e.g. sum of absolute or squared errors).
